findings.failure_path: The stated pass condition checks aggregate score and cost. A lost safety gate in one case can be offset by improvements elsewhere, allowing the redesign to pass. One run per case and an undefined 'beyond noise' tolerance also leave the acceptance decision unreproducible.
findings.smallest_fix: Make every required critical-hazard assertion an independent merge veto, and specify the numerical non-regression threshold and repetition policy for score and cost.
